Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.pipeline_done (the source runs on the events pipeline, parent_pipeline when its file names no trigger; Woodpecker has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat when its file names no trigger; Woodpecker has no event for them)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created/step/fail step.if: pull request test (Woodpecker holds the target branch in CI_COMMIT_BRANCH on a pull request, so the condition gains a pull request test; the source condition is kept in a marker)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-publish job.if: pull request test (Woodpecker holds the target branch in CI_COMMIT_BRANCH on a pull request, so the condition gains a pull request test; the source condition is kept in a marker)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.manual: manual or deployment event (the source runs on these events when its file names no trigger; Woodpecker starts each as its nearest event: api as manual, trigger as manual)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release ext.passthrough: inline child jobs (the child pipeline ci/release.yml runs inline as jobs release-created, release-publish; the job release-created fails when the workflow rules of the child pipeline do not create it, as GitLab fails the trigger job, and every job that needs the call waits for it; a variable that a run sets by hand reads as unset in the child conditions, as GitLab does not forward it without forward:pipeline_variables, but its value can reach the scripts of the child jobs; a return to GitLab restores the call and the child file only with the round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created/step/fail step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created/step/pass step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
